scope: incremental enhancement of existing notebook-first v3; no raw media published

predi_covid.code_license: no LICENSE identified in inspected repository; no upstream code copied

subset.selection: np.random.default_rng(42);120 of sorted296 participant IDs;reading task1;max2 earliest;label-blind

label_definition.1: I am fatigued OR I do not feel well

predi_covid.annotation_resolution: same-day clinical self-report, not within-utterance fatigue
predi_covid.split: fixed seed42 subject-disjoint three-way; repeat days stay within participant; no tuning on test
missing_metadata: precise label-response timestamp relative to recording
predi_covid.domain_gap: clinical COVID speech is not radio ATC / occupational fatigue
predi_covid.publication: safe aggregate only; no WAV, full feature/label table, participant identifiers or models in Git

cogbeacon.access: successful public GitHub archive download; EEG not downloaded
cogbeacon.rights: MIT LICENSE explicitly software; article describes data-sharing approval/IRB2019-0253; no automatic biometric redistribution assumption

local_audit.count_discrepancy: current archive has 77 sessions / 20 numeric IDs; source documentation says 76 / 19

cogbeacon.annotation: native cumulative button count per task round; not binary frame/window fatigue
cogbeacon.identity: b suffix is second day of same numeric source ID
cogbeacon.time_alignment: round IDs align; local frame index resets; verified absolute timestamps unavailable; response Time not a synchronization clock
cogbeacon.training_status: deliberately not run; no invented scores
cogbeacon.sampling_limitation: nominal2FPS insufficient for blink duration/PERCLOS claims
cogbeacon.publication: aggregate event/coverage charts only; no landmark coordinates or raw biometrics in Git
